title: Water-borne chitosan/CuO-GO nanocomposite as an antibacterial coating for functional leather with enhanced mechanical and thermal properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12162-12178
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00225G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Khandaker Tanzim Rahman, Md. Nur-E. Alam, M. Nuruzzaman Khan
A nanocomposite coating was applied to the leather surface by LBL spraying, followed by durable cross-linking. The CS/CuO-GO coatings are highly effective and deliver outstanding antibacterial activity through a “kill-release” mechanism.
